apps.name: Similar Photos
apps.versionDescription: Find visually similar photos in your library using Vision framework fingerprinting. Paste from clipboard or pick from library.
apps.localizedDescription: Similar Photos scans your photo library and builds a visual fingerprint index. Search by picking a photo or pasting from clipboard to find visually similar images. Shows similarity percentage, photo date, and location.

permissions.usageDescription: Scans your photo library to build a visual similarity index.
